messages:
Aisha Kumar: Quick sync — cluster-7 dedicated capacity readiness check. Need go/no-go for reservation next Monday. Owners: @matt, @sarah, @diego. Major blockers?

Matt Lee: Procurement update — 12x H100s arrived at warehouse yesterday. Racking kit still pending (ETA Thu). If racking slips we might only get 16 nodes live instead of 24. I'll follow up with vendor.

Sarah Park: Rack power test failed on Rack-3 during the 24->48V switchover. Logs: ```rackctl health --rack rack-3``` output shows ERROR: PSU sync fail x2. Eng-infra on it, probably a power distribution unit config.

Diego Ramos: Heads-up — I opened IAAS ansible CR for the reservation playbook (PR #492). Needs @nora for templating review and netdev for BGP template confirmation. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/ansible/pull/492

Nora Patel: I'll take the CR tonight. BGP template change is backwards-compatible; tagging @sarah for the power-retry window so we can coordinate.

infra-qa-bot: Automated smoke results for cluster-7 (staging): 18/24 nodes passed kernel + NV driver tests. Failed: node-17, node-19, node-22. Common failure: GPU driver mismatch (expected 535.54).

Sarah Park: Confirmed driver mismatch on those nodes. Reflash scheduled 02:00 UTC. If reflash passes, plan to bump reservation target to 22 nodes.

Aisha Kumar: Can someone pre-seed a reservation (soft hold) so we don't lose the slot while we clear infra? Need example command + PR to reference. Also what is the fallback if racking kit misses Thu?

Matt Lee: Reservation command example: ```redwood-cli reservations create --pool cluster-7 --nodes 22 --start 2026-03-23T09:00Z --duration 72h``` I'll open a soft hold now and cancel if racking misses ETA.

Diego Ramos: Fallback plan: shift to cluster-5 (same AZ) but that requires a small model config tweak (batch size) and an easy canary. @nora can prep the canary config.

Nora Patel: Canary config PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/configs/pull/118 — sets batch_size=8 for the model worker and reduces concurrency. I'll add automated rollout steps and a rollback tag to the PR.

Aisha Kumar: Next steps: Matt to update procurement ETA by EOD; Sarah to post post-reflash smoke results; Nora to merge CR and prep canary. If all green, I'll trigger the reservation Monday morning. :thumbsup:

Matt Lee: Got it — will update EOD. If racking slips I'll escalate to the vendor rep and request overnight shipment.
